pages.text: The name is the role. Every Igor is called Igor. Igors who marry adopt the family surname but keep Igor as professional designation.$(br2)Never ask $(italic)which$() Igor.
Igors are surgeons and transplanters. The stitched face and mismatched eyes are marks of craft, not defects.$(br2)If an Igor offers medical help, accept it. They are $(italic)very$() good at it.
The Igor Network is one of the oldest organizations in the world. Every Igor maintains spare parts from previous generations.$(br2)$(7)"A good Igor never wastes."
